text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! I suddenly feel so much more
powerful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's like cherry blossoms are budding
inside me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this means I'll be able to burst
into full
bloom any day now! I have to go
tell Trainer!
